scalar_comparison.scope: 保留Scalar时间口径／量化差异，未用于校准单位；时间轴使用工具报告区间

long_pc_calibration.method: 同PC的非Scalar、非同步指令trace区间并集对照CSV运行时间（cycles使用时长和）；排除同步等待口径及不足0.1us的舍入项
long_pc_calibration.calibration_policy: Independent CSV>=1us PCs at original 5% tolerance; short-PC errors <=0.011us with equal event counts retained in resolution review.
